sentence: This project studies how non-local games can be used to understand quantum entanglement through mathematical analysis.
This project builds a computing system with graphical processing units to support research on artificial intelligence that works with images, video, audio and text.
This project designs and delivers a set of courses on artificial intelligence for an undergraduate computer science program.
This project tests liquid crystal elastomers in complex states of deformation and builds mathematical models of how they behave.
This project builds computing tools that use graphs to describe how cells are organized in the developing zebrafish retina.
This project tries to grow cubic boron arsenide as thin films and large single crystals and to design devices made from it using artificial intelligence.
This project creates hands-on activities that show how modern agriculture equipment uses robotics, sensors and artificial intelligence to collect field data.
This project studies quantum invariants that describe the shape of three- and four-dimensional manifolds.
This project engineers tiny particles called exosomes from stem cells to change macrophages so that inflammation is reduced and bones heal.
This project develops ways to remove harmful or private content from large language models without retraining them from scratch.
This project builds a compliant robotic arm and software that translate written language into accessible outputs with haptic feedback.
This project develops light sensors called single-photon avalanche diodes and tries to tailor their avalanche currents to improve the signal-to-noise ratio at room temperature.
This project builds a framework for designing safe control laws for robotics and power systems from data.
This project builds a wearable device that continuously senses physiological signals for biometric authentication and health monitoring.
This project combines measurements from instrumented vehicles, unmanned aerial vehicles and bridge-mounted sensors to assess bridge safety while traffic continues to flow.
This project studies how quantum information processing can make covert ranging and reflectance sensing more secure and accurate.
This project studies how plant roots and shoots relate to each other and to plant communities and the soil ecosphere.
